item.title: Portuguese Law Enforcement Clears Housing Protestors
item.description: Demonstrators demonstrating over affordability issues in Portugal engaged in physical altercations with law enforcement personnel.

item.title: Michigan Senate Race Sees Cross-Party Endorsement
item.description: Following a primary defeat, Democrat Haley Stevens has thrown her support behind the Republican contender in the upcoming Michigan Senate election.

item.title: Warnock hid seizures from Liverpool as a youngster
item.description: As reported by BBC Sport, Former Premier League footballer Stephen Warnock states he hid seizures from Liverpool as a youngster because he feared he would be released. Key points: Warnock, Liverpool, Former Premier League, Stephen Warnock.

item.title: Al Jazeera Marks Three Decades of Broadcasting
item.description: The media organization has marked its thirtieth year of global news delivery since its inaugural transmission in 1996.

item.title: Cyclone Murasu Triggers Alerts and Closures
item.description: Meteorologists tracked the storm hundreds of kilometers from several coastal cities, prompting educational closures and severe weather warnings across multiple districts.

item.title: Exit Surveys Indicate Bulgarian Presidential Runoff Victory
item.description: Initial polls show the incumbent securing the runoff amidst heightened regional security worries stemming from Black Sea drone incidents.

item.title: German Top-Flight Football Eighth Round Action
item.description: A compilation of key moments and goals from the eighth matchday of the current Bundesliga season is now available for viewing.

item.title: Arsenal Defeats Anfield Drought After Previous Setback
item.description: Following a disappointing loss against Fleetwood, Arsenal secured a historic three-point lead at the Premier League summit with a long-awaited victory at Anfield.

item.title: Minor surrenders to police regarding Bradley Lowery video
item.description: Following a Coventry City investigation into footage mocking Sunderland fans with an image of Bradley Lowery, a 14-year-old surrendered to West Midlands Police.

item.title: Report indicates phone conversation between Trump and Netanyahu
item.description: Axios reported that Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu discussed the Iran conflict by phone. An Israeli insider characterized the talk as tough, whereas an American source termed it direct.

item.title: Ukrainian power outages follow Russian strikes near Kherson
item.description: Russian attacks left thousands of Ukrainians without electricity as a humanitarian truce in Kherson neared its conclusion. This brief ceasefire enabled residents to leave the Russian-held city of Oleshky.

item.title: Ecuadorian floods cause residential building collapse on video
item.description: Heavy downpours and El Nino-related floods in Ecuador prompted local residents to record footage of a home sliding into an overflowing river.

item.title: Kaliningrad radar installation by Russia concerns NATO
item.description: Moscow is close to finishing a massive radar facility in Kaliningrad that can observe vast areas of Europe. Analysts caution that this development may heighten tensions between NATO and Russia.

item.title: IT department investigates tech couple for tax evasion
item.description: Income tax authorities targeted a technology professional couple accused of making fraudulent claims and dodging 5.3 crore rupees in land taxes.

item.title: সংসদীয় কমিটিতে উড়োজাহাজ ক্রয় নিয়ে সম্ভাব্যতা যাচাইয়ের প্রশ্ন
item.description: বেসামরিক বিমান পরিবহন ও পর্যটন মন্ত্রণালয় সম্পর্কিত সংসদীয় কমিটির বৈঠকে বিমান কেনার আগে কোনো সম্ভাব্যতা যাচাই করা হয়েছিল কি না, সে বিষয়ে প্রশ্ন উত্থাপন করা হয়।

item.title: Arsenal defeats Liverpool at Anfield to lead Premier League
item.description: Arsenal secured a three-point advantage at the summit of the Premier League standings by claiming their first victory at Anfield since 2012, leaving Liverpool empty-handed after a competitive match.

item.title: Israel Election Authority Defends Probe Integrity
item.description: Israel's election commissioner stated that an ongoing investigation into potential irregularities will not invalidate the vote outcome. The Shin Bet initiated this probe into allegations that the Raam party received Qatari funds, claims strongly rejected by both parties.

item.title: Municipalities Face Hurdles Ending Flock Safety Deals
item.description: Several municipalities report challenges when attempting to terminate their agreements with Flock Safety. For instance, Plymouth, Minnesota, voted to drop the vendor in September, yet encountered significant hurdles in the process.

item.title: প্রধানমন্ত্রীকে নিয়ে কুরুচিপূর্ণ মন্তব্যকারী যুবকের স্বীকারোক্তি
item.description: প্রধানমন্ত্রীকে বহনকারী বাসের ছবিতে আপত্তিকর মন্তব্য করার অভিযোগে গ্রেফতার আবু বকর সিদ্দিক আদালতে স্বীকারোক্তিমূলক জবানবন্দি দিয়েছেন। তদন্ত কর্মকর্তা জানান, তিনি এই মামলার একমাত্র এজাহারনামীয় আসামি।

item.title: NT Water Strategy Revision Denounced by Environmentalists
item.description: Environmental organizations have strongly criticized the Northern Territory administration for attempting to eliminate mandatory environmental water allocations. Critics characterized the proposed legislative amendment as an aggressive disregard for ecological preservation.

item.title: Barter System Sustains Northeast Drug Trade
item.description: The illicit drug trade within the northeastern sector of the Golden Triangle heavily relies on barter transactions to function and persist.

item.title: UN Western Sahara Peacekeeping Mission Concludes
item.description: The United Nations peacekeeping operation in Western Sahara concluded on Sunday after thirty-five years following the Security Council's failure to extend its mandate. Morocco expressed approval of the outcome, whereas opposing factions from Algeria viewed it differently.

item.title: ট্রাইব্যুনালে কেবল পলাতক বিচার নিয়ে জামায়াতের দাবি ভিত্তিহীন
item.description: ট্রাইব্যুনালে শুধু পলাতক আসামিদের বিচার ও সাজা দেওয়া হয় বলে জামায়াত নেতার দেওয়া বক্তব্য সঠিক নয় বলে জানিয়েছেন প্রসিকিউটর। সম্প্রতি এক সংবাদ সম্মেলনে জামায়াতের সেক্রেটারি জেনারেল এই অভিযোগ করেছিলেন।

item.title: কলকাতায় দেশের প্রথম সরকারি ম্যাজিক ইনস্টিটিউট চালু হচ্ছে
item.description: ঐতিহ্যবাহী জাদুশিল্পকে টিকিয়ে রাখতে পশ্চিমবঙ্গের সরকার কলকাতায় দেশের প্রথম সরকারি ম্যাজিক ইনস্টিটিউট স্থাপনের পদক্ষেপ নিয়েছে। প্রখ্যাত জাদুকর পি সি সরকারের নামানুসারে এই প্রতিষ্ঠানটি গড়ে তোলা হবে।

item.title: UK Dropped Slavery Reparations from Formal Chogm Schedule
item.description: British authorities initially strongly opposed including slavery reparations on the Commonwealth summit program. Although the UK prime minister later consented to structured talks on reparatory justice, the topic stayed off the official agenda.

item.title: Iraola puzzled by penalty decision in Arsenal loss
item.description: Following a home loss to league leaders Arsenal, manager Andoni Iraola stated he fails to comprehend why Alexander Isak was denied a penalty.

item.title: পায়রা বন্দরে বিদেশি জাহাজের আগমন কমছে
item.description: পণ্য খালাস পদ্ধতি কেবল বন্দর কর্তৃপক্ষের নয়, বরং কাস্টম হাউস, সিঅ্যান্ডএফ এজেন্ট ও শিপিং লাইনের মতো বিভিন্ন পক্ষের ওপর নির্ভরশীল বলে প্রতিবেদনে উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে।

item.title: Democratic protest ends peacefully outside BMC office
item.description: The protest outside the BMC headquarters wrapped up without incident after speeches and slogans. Organizers chose to call off the march to Mantralaya.

item.title: Cambridge Scientist Dr Marta Shahbazi Dies in Spanish Train Derailment
item.description: University of Cambridge researcher Dr Marta Shahbazi was among the victims of Wednesday's train crash in Spain. She had been en route to accept an award for excellence in developmental biology.

item.title: কক্সবাজারে নলকূপ খননের সময় গ্যাস ও আগুন
item.description: নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করতে স্থানটির ১০০ মিটারের মধ্যে জনসাধারণের প্রবেশ নিষিদ্ধ করা হয়েছে। স্থানীয় প্রশাসন পরিস্থিতি নিয়ন্ত্রণে প্রয়োজনীয় পদক্ষেপ নিয়েছে।

item.title: মিরপুরে সহিংসতা পরিকল্পনায় ৪৯ জন আটক
item.description: গোয়েন্দা পুলিশ জানিয়েছে, মিরপুরে শ্রমিক আন্দোলনের সুযোগ নিয়ে সহিংসতা ঘটানোর পরিকল্পনা করছিলেন স্থানীয় আওয়ামী লীগের গ্রেপ্তারকৃত নেতাকর্মী ও কর্মীরা।

item.title: Methods to obtain Amazon Prime at no or low cost
item.description: Users are advised against paying full price, as they may already be eligible for discounted rates or existing perks covering membership.

item.title: JU VC initiates inquiry into employee molestation claim
item.description: The Vice-Chancellor of JU has formally directed an investigation regarding a harassment accusation lodged against a staff member.

item.title: Arteta says Fleetwood defeat sparked Anfield victory
item.description: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta feels their League Cup defeat to Fleetwood motivated the team to secure their initial Anfield win in 14 years.

item.title: Arsenal Secures Away Victory Against Liverpool to Claim Top Spot
item.description: Arsenal defeated Liverpool at Anfield to secure their first away win at the stadium since 2012. The result places the club three points ahead of Manchester City at the summit of the table.

item.title: India Records 23 Percent Increase in October Goods and Services Tax
item.description: India's Goods and Services Tax revenue collections grew by a record 23 percent in October. Total collections reached Rs 2.3 lakh crore during the month.

item.title: Florida Resident Maintains Seven-Decade Archive of Celebrity Memorabilia
item.description: A collector in Florida has spent 70 years gathering celebrity items. The diverse assortment features a handwritten letter by actress Elizabeth Taylor.

item.title: Demonstrations Across German Cities Turn Violent and Result in Looting
item.description: Large peaceful gatherings in Germany deteriorated into unrest and theft. Clashes and disturbances were reported in Frankfurt, Berlin, Cologne, and Hamburg.

item.title: Government Contractor Selection Rules Updated to Include Newcomers
item.description: Contractors can no longer be barred from public projects due to a lack of extensive experience, high annual turnover, or prior large-scale project history. These changes open new opportunities for beginners in government work.

item.title: Ohio Parents Reportedly Mailed Infant via Postal Service in 1913
item.description: Following the 1913 introduction of the Parcel Post service for larger packages, some US parents mailed their young children to cut travel costs. Notable cases included the shipment of six-year-old May Pierstorff.

item.title: Conflict Involving Iran Emerges as Key Factor in US Midterm Elections
item.description: The ongoing war has turned into a major topic of discussion leading up to the upcoming Tuesday ballot. Observers are analyzing how the overseas conflict might influence the legislative elections.

item.title: French Authorities Launch Investigation After Petrol Bombs Target Police
item.description: French prosecutors have initiated an attempted murder inquiry following petrol bomb assaults on law enforcement officers during Saturday demonstrations. Multiple security personnel sustained injuries, and no suspects have been detained yet.

item.title: Industrial disparity: One-tenth of plants drive majority of production
item.description: Data reveals a stark industrial divide where the top ten percent of production facilities generate nearly three-quarters of total output.

item.title: আর্সেনালের শীর্ষস্থান পুনরুদ্ধার
item.description: দীর্ঘ চোদ্দো বছর পর অ্যানফিল্ড স্টেডিয়ামে জয় পেয়ে ইংলিশ প্রিমিয়ার লিগের পয়েন্ট তালিকার মগডালে উঠে এসেছে আর্সেনাল। লিভারপুলের বিরুদ্ধে এই ম্যাচে তারা এক শূন্য গোলে জয়লাভ করে।

item.title: শিক্ষার্থীদের নিয়ে তারুণ্যের পৃথিবী অনুষ্ঠান
item.description: স্টামফোর্ড ইউনিভার্সিটি এবং প্রথম আলোর যৌথ আয়োজনে শিক্ষার্থীদের কর্মজীবন সচেতনতা নিয়ে একটি সেশন অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। সেখানে সঠিক সময়ে কাজ সম্পন্ন করা, লক্ষ্য অর্জনে পরিশ্রম এবং সফট স্কিল বাড়ানোর নানা উপায় নিয়ে আলোচনা করা হয়।

item.title: Enabling Android Flashlight Without Device Unlocking
item.description: Users of Google Pixel and Samsung Galaxy handsets can quickly activate their built-in flashlights without needing to unlock the screen first.

item.title: India Faces Decent Work Deficit Despite Lower Unemployment
item.description: While jobless rates decline in India, a shortage of quality employment negatively impacts overall economic expansion. Lacking social safety nets, unprotected laborers cut spending, reduce savings, and face heightened financial risks.

item.title: U.S. Midterms: Election Administrators Face Growing Pressure
item.description: While jobless rates decline in India, a shortage of quality employment negatively impacts overall economic expansion. Lacking social safety nets, unprotected laborers cut spending, reduce savings, and face heightened financial risks.

item.title: নগদের অবরুদ্ধ শেয়ার মুক্তির আবেদন ও দুদকের অবস্থান
item.description: নগদের ফ্রিজ করা ৭৮৬ কোটি টাকার শেয়ার ছাড়ানোর আবেদন নিয়ে সোমবার ঢাকার বিশেষ জজ আদালতে শুনানি নির্ধারিত রয়েছে। দুর্নীতি দমন কমিশন এই শেয়ারগুলো অবমুক্ত করার প্রচেষ্টার তীব্র প্রতিবাদ জানাবে।

item.title: US Representative Stevens Backs Republican Senate Contender Rogers
item.description: After failing to win the Democratic primary against Abdul El-Sayed, US Representative Haley Stevens has thrown her support behind his Republican rival in the Senate contest.

item.title: EPFO Invests 17,000 Crore in Stocks During First Quarter
item.description: During the initial quarter, the retirement fund body invested 17,000 crore rupees into stock markets. By the conclusion of June, its total equity holdings reached 11.2 percent.

item.title: ISRO Faces Resource Constraints for GSLV-F18 Mission Goals
item.description: The space agency requires additional personnel and physical supplies to successfully achieve its objectives. This assessment highlights the slow recovery of the GSLV-F18 mission.

item.title: শাহরুখ খানের সম্পদের পরিমাণ ১৩ হাজার কোটি টাকা অতিক্রম করেছে
item.description: হুরুন ইন্ডিয়ার ২০২৬ সালের তথ্য অনুযায়ী, অভিনেতা শাহরুখ খানের মোট সম্পত্তির আর্থিক মূল্যায়ন প্রায় ১৩ হাজার ৬০০ কোটি টাকায় পৌঁছেছে।

item.title: Court Rules xAI Must Defend Against NAACP Pollution Complaint
item.description: A magistrate decided that the artificial intelligence firm must confront litigation brought by the NAACP. The dispute centers on environmental emissions from facilities located in southern Memphis.

item.title: Global Action Needed Against US Embargo on Cuba, Says Report
item.description: International players, including India, ought to oppose American pressure tactics regarding Cuba. The commentary addresses diminishing backing for the ongoing US sanctions.

item.title: Michigan Electoral Dynamics and US Midterm Campaign Review
item.description: Gavin Lee examines final-stage campaign events alongside Columbia University political science professor Donald Green. The discussion highlights crucial electoral regions during the US political overview.

item.title: Actor Chad Lowe Puts California Residence on the Market
item.description: Weeks following the passing of their 13-year-old child Fiona, Chad Lowe and Kim Painter placed their Mar Vista property on sale. The couple is asking 3.249 million dollars for the four-bedroom house.

item.title: Minister Triggers Debate Over Proposed State Flag for Tamil Nadu
item.description: A cabinet official noted that unlike numerous other regions, Tamil Nadu lacks an official banner. He announced that a distinct emblem for the state will soon be established.

item.title: Alaska Senate Result Accepted as US Court Throws Out Federal Case
item.description: Senator Sullivan has committed to accepting the final election results in Alaska. Meanwhile, the Department of Justice faced a setback as a federal judge threw out their legal challenge against the state's certification process.

item.title: Hibernian Secures League Cup Final Spot After Avoiding Late Collapse
item.description: Hibernian broke their pattern of conceding late goals to defeat opponents and advance to the League Cup final. They will now face Rangers in the upcoming championship match, according to analyst Tom English.
